text:
Predicates:
Winner(x, y) ::: x is the winner of event y.
Participated(x, y) ::: x participated in event y.
Tie(n, y) ::: there was an n-way tie in event y.
From(x, c) ::: x is from country c.
OnLeaderboard(x, y) ::: x is on the leaderboard of event y.

Premises:
Winner(steinhauer, duMaurierClassic1992) ::: The winner of the 1992 du Maurier Classic was Steinhauer.
Participated(steinhauer, duMaurierClassic1992) ::: Steinhauer participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
Tie(6, duMaurierClassic1992) ∧ ∃x (From(x, belgium) ∧ OnLeaderboard(x, duMaurierClassic1992)) ::: There was one six-way tie on the leaderboard and one person in the six-way tie was from Belgium.
From(descampe, belgium) ∧ OnLeaderboard(descampe, duMaurierClassic1992) ::: Descampe is from Belgium and is on the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
∀x (OnLeaderboard(x, duMaurierClassic1992) → Participated(x, duMaurierClassic1992)) ::: All people on the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.

Conclusion:
OnLeaderboard(descampe, duMaurierClassic1992) ∧ InTie(descampe, 6, duMaurierClassic1992) ::: Descampe is in the six-way tie in the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
